# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update ahead of the stable release. It brings the current upstream renderer to the 4.154 line without changing the managed API surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154, giving preview consumers the current upstream engine while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API surface. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
